# Ridgeline Roofing Co.

> Owner-operated roofing contractor serving Indianapolis, IN and the
> surrounding metro since 2008. Roof replacement, roof repair, and storm
> damage restoration. Every free estimate includes a drone inspection and a
> photo report the homeowner keeps, plus a written fixed-price quote. All
> work is performed by in-house crews; no subcontractors.
> Tagline: "Over your head. Under control."

Phone: (317) 555-0148
Email: hello@ridgelineroofing.com
Owner: Dan Whitaker
Service area: Indianapolis, Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield,
Zionsville, Greenwood, Avon, Brownsburg, Lawrence, Beech Grove, and Geist.

Key facts: Typical asphalt roof life in central Indiana is 18 to 25 years.
Ridgeline performs full tear-offs only, never overlays. Deck repair is
priced per sheet before tear-off, so the fixed-price quote does not change
mid-job. Most replacements finish in one to two days.

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://www.ridgelineroofing.com/services/roof-replacement/): Full tear-off and system rebuild with documented deck repair and balanced ventilation.
- [Roof Repair](https://www.ridgelineroofing.com/services/roof-repair/): Leak tracing and permanent detail rebuilds: flashing, valleys, pipe boots, wind damage.
- [Storm Damage Restoration](https://www.ridgelineroofing.com/services/storm-damage-restoration/): Emergency tarping, timestamped damage documentation, and full restoration.
- [5-Step Replacement Process](https://www.ridgelineroofing.com/roof-replacement-process/): Inspection, tear-off, deck repair, water barriers, spec installation.
